title: The Green Book  Membrane Travel Guide

inspiration.green_book: Victor Hugo Green, 1936-1967. Listed safe stops for Black travelers during segregation. A survival map, not just a directory.
inspiration.michelin: Michelin Guide. Tire company that mapped restaurants to make people drive more. The guide IS the product.
inspiration.diners_club: First credit card, 1950. Frank McNamara forgot his wallet. One card, many destinations. The NETWORK effect.

pattern: A curated list of SAFE/GOOD/TRUSTED destinations, with distances and routing between them, that guides travelers through potentially hostile territory. The GUIDE itself becomes the value.

the_inversion.before: humans lost in the maze, minotaur hunts them
the_inversion.after: humans walk the Green Book, minotaur guards the maze
the_inversion.human_path: 50 safe stops, nav-ring on every page, Ariadne's string, pheromone trail, SCENIC ROUTE
the_inversion.fleet_path: 282 data JSONs behind blackwall, no navigation, no string, minotaur's training ground
